seo.title: OCR PDF — Make Scanned PDFs Searchable | JPdf
seo.description: Add a searchable, selectable text layer to a scanned or image-only PDF. Free, fast, and private — no installation required.

subtitle: Make a scanned PDF's text searchable and selectable.

howItWorks.title: How to OCR a PDF
steps: Upload the scanned or image-only PDF.
Choose the document's language and click Start.
Download the PDF with a searchable text layer.

items.a: It recognizes the text in scanned page images and adds it as a hidden, selectable text layer underneath — the page still looks the same, but you can now search, select, and copy its text.

items.q: Will this touch pages that already have real text?
items.a: No — pages that already contain a text layer are left untouched; only image-only pages are processed.
Yes, OCR is free within the daily usage limits shown above — note these limits are lower than most other tools, since OCR is significantly more resource-intensive per page.

items.q: Will my file be kept private?
items.a: Yes. Files are processed securely and automatically deleted after a short retention period.
